title: La Patrona de Apan, MEXI STORIES
comment: manteles-apan (MEXI): patio de una hacienda pulquera en Apan, Hidalgo, durante una comida. Caras comunes, no famosas; los cuatro se distinguen a simple vista.

chars.CLEMENCIA_ARRIAGA: Mexican woman, owner of a pulque hacienda, 66 years old, fair skin, silver hair in a high elegant chignon, thin arched eyebrows, a cream silk blouse with a jade brooch at the collar, a long black skirt, black low heels, her hands empty.
chars.RENATA_SOLIS: Mexican woman, 42 years old, warm brown skin, long wavy black hair worn loose, elegant and serene, gold hoop earrings, a fitted emerald-green dress with long sleeves, nude heels, a small black handbag, her hands empty.
chars.BERNARDO_ARRIAGA: Mexican man, 44 years old, light skin, slicked-back black hair, a thin black mustache, a navy-blue blazer over an open-collar white shirt, grey trousers, black shoes, his hands empty.
chars.TOMASA_HERNANDEZ: Mexican woman from Hidalgo, longtime cook of the hacienda, 63 years old, brown skin, grey hair in two long braids, a plain lilac long-sleeve blouse, a dark-grey rebozo over her shoulders, a long dark skirt, sandals, her hands empty.

locs.LOC_HACIENDAAPAN: Inner patio of an old pulque hacienda in Apan, Hidalgo, at midday: red-ochre walls, stone archways, a long table covered with a white embroidered tablecloth, clay jugs and glasses, potted geraniums, maguey fields beyond the archways under a blue sky, no readable text, no signs, no logos, no people.
